test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a family of four persons there is only one child. B is A's wife and D's daughter. If C is A's daughter, how is C related to D?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

According to given conditions,

1) B is A's wife and D's daughter. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3a51727b5b7a27a24db3df06b870bd974d548d1c192d9ca0733484e6d806457.png] 

2) C is A's daughter

3) In a family of four persons there is only one child.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26cf0460ae3b6a184cddbd75a0e6f6df8e409a594d9438d53b4d606d07097c0f.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree C is the granddaughter i.e daughter's daughter of D.

Hence, "**Daughter's daughter**" is the correct answer.
